title: Public portfolio manifest
description: Versioned, language-neutral catalog of public project metadata for the portfolio site. Required payload fields identify the catalog revision and the manifest hash; projects[] carries one entry per public project. Source URLs and surface URLs MUST be HTTPS, MUST NOT point at admin/account/private paths, and the project id is unique across the catalog. No arbitrary metadata map is allowed.

schema_family.description: The contract family this manifest conforms to. Always platform.public-portfolio-manifest.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema this document conforms to.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at which the producer emitted this manifest.

manifest_revision.description: Stable producer-side revision identifier (for example, a content hash or a sequence tag).

manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form of the projects[] catalog (without the manifest envelope). Consumers may use this to detect catalog drift.

projects.description: Approved public projects. May be empty for a first-run or temporarily empty catalog.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe project identifier. Unique across the catalog.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS source repository URL. MUST NOT point at admin, account, private, or internal paths.

demo_url.description: Optional public HTTPS demo URL. MUST be HTTPS and MUST NOT point at admin, account, private, or internal paths.

visibility.description: Only public projects are allowed in the public manifest.

featured.description: Optional flag a consumer may use to pin the project in a 'featured' section.

showcase_status.description: Communication status, not production readiness. The site renders this; it does not gate deploys.

surfaces.description: Optional list of public surfaces a consumer can link to. Each surface requires a public label and an HTTPS URL.

status_evidence.description: Optional safe evidence object describing the showcase_status. Descriptive only; may be stale.

source.description: Identifier for the evidence source (for example, 'forge/build-status' or 'ci/manual').
